import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group by breed and count the number of dogs
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().reset_index()
breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Select the top 10 breeds
top_10_breeds = breed_counts.head(10)

# Create a bar plot of the top 10 breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=top_10_breeds, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group by breed and count the number of dogs
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().reset_index()
breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Select the top 10 breeds
top_10_breeds = breed_counts.head(10)

# Create a bar plot of the top 10 breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=top_10_breeds, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
